object_description: compact two-story volume with integrated courtyard and shed-like rooflights
design_condition: The compact volume is positioned with sufficient distance from adjacent buildings, accessed from a new western road, and filtered from neighbouring residences by tree planting while incorporating the vehicle lock and walking yard.

positive.statement: The compact new building fits into the overall complex and remains spatially compatible with the adjacent buildings.

position.rationale: The compact two-story volume is visible across the plan and all elevations.

positive.statement: Tree plantings provide a spatial filter to the neighbouring residential buildings.

position.rationale: Landscape screening is absent as geometry, so it is anchored along the likely neighbouring-building edge.

positive.statement: The western development route and existing parking make the address accessible to visitors and deliveries.

position.target: western development route and existing parking
position.rationale: The access and parking approach are constrained to the western ground-level edge.

positive.statement: The wooden facades create a homely overall impression and a facade compatible with the environment.

position.rationale: Facade material is not sampled, but the west-facing envelope is clearly localized in elevation views.

positive.statement: The compact volume makes the project cost-effective.

position.rationale: Cost effectiveness is an overall judgment without a useful geometric location.

positive.statement: A friendly atmosphere is created through the urban development and the architecture of the facades and roof.

position.rationale: The broad impression is anchored across the visible upper envelope and rooflight zone.

positive.statement: The walking yard gains a sense of scale through its connecting staircase to the living floor.

position.rationale: The yard and external connection are approximated at the lower courtyard-facing portion of the mass.

negative.statement: The walking yard could be problematically visible from the neighbouring residential buildings.

position.rationale: The potentially exposed yard is anchored to the courtyard-facing lower zone.

negative.statement: The shed-like rooflight design does not correspond to the building structure, floor plan or section.

position.rationale: Rooflight features are visibly concentrated in the upper-right roof area and elevations.

negative.statement: Separating the patient rooms and lounges from the walking yard by a covered external staircase is negative in terms of safety.

position.target: covered external staircase separating rooms and yard
position.rationale: The staircase is approximated beside the yard, though adjacent interior rooms are not distinguishable.

negative.statement: Winding corridors and distant rooms require considerable monitoring work during operation.

position.rationale: Interior circulation is not directly sampled, so it is placed within the central building footprint.

negative.statement: The north orientation of the intensive-care rooms is problematic.

position.rationale: The room zone is constrained to the northern upper portion of the sampled volume.

negative.statement: The floor plan has major deficiencies in use and safety.

position.rationale: Plan deficiencies are spatially assigned to a representative lower-level area of the visible footprint.
